svc-b5cda2736871.title: Cloudflare outage: Cloudflare Dashboard and Cloudflare API service issues in EU region
svc-b5cda2736871.summary: Cloudflare's own status page says it investigated Dashboard and API issues in the EU region from 18:24 UTC on 20 Nov, implemented a fix at 18:38 and resolved it at 18:53. It says CDN cached-file serving was not affected.

pw-gn-ua-ukraine-2026111822.title: Power outage reported in Ukraine (20 publishers)
pw-gn-ua-ukraine-2026111822.summary: Fakty ICTV, citing Ukrenergo, and Novyny.LIVE, citing the Energy Ministry, report emergency outages and lost supply in several Ukrainian regions on 19 Nov. Both attribute them to Russian attacks damaging energy equipment. Neither gives a customer figure.
pw-gn-ua-ukraine-2026111822.cause: Fakty ICTV says Ukrenergo attributed it to Russian attacks on energy infrastructure; Novyny.LIVE says the Energy Ministry attributed it to shelling damage

pw-gn-au-south-australia-2026111908.title: Power outage reported in South Australia (2 publishers)
pw-gn-au-south-australia-2026111908.summary: ABC reported that a storm cell toppled three transmission towers on 19 Nov and that about 24,000 properties on the Eyre Peninsula lost power; The Nightly also reported about 23,000 properties. ElectraNet is quoted by ABC.
pw-gn-au-south-australia-2026111908.cause: A storm cell toppled three transmission towers, according to ABC; SA Power Networks said outages were believed connected to a possible lightning strike on the ElectraNet network
pw-gn-au-south-australia-2026111908.figures: About 24,000 properties on the Eyre Peninsula (ABC); about 23,000 properties (The Nightly)

pw-gn-au-adelaide-2026111822.title: Power outage reported in Adelaide (8 publishers)
pw-gn-au-adelaide-2026111822.summary: ABC and The Nightly reported storm-related power cuts on the Eyre Peninsula, South Australia, on 19 Nov. The Nightly gave about 23,000 properties; ABC quoted SA Power Networks at about 24,000 customers. This is not an Adelaide-city outage.
pw-gn-au-adelaide-2026111822.cause: Storm activity; SA Power Networks said it was believed connected to a possible lightning strike on the ElectraNet transmission network (ABC)
pw-gn-au-adelaide-2026111822.figures: About 23,000 properties (The Nightly); about 24,000 customers (SA Power Networks, via ABC)
